# udoma_catalog_group (Resource)

Resource represents a catalog group



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `code` (String) User provided unique identifier for the catalog group.

### Optional

- `description` (Map of String) Optional localized description of the catalog group.
- `published` (Boolean) Whether the group is published and available for use.
- `required_scopes` (List of String) Account scopes required for this group to be available for subscription.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier for the catalog group.
